permutation_convention: Zero-based tuples p[0..7]; (a*b)[i]=a[b[i]], with rightmost permutation applied first. These are literal tuples, never enumeration indices.
Fox_convention: Left Fox derivative d(uv)=d(u)+u*d(v); R_j=F_j*x_j^(-1), j zero-based.

uniform_family.base: literal beta17 from bound ordinary presentation
uniform_family.reason: The terminal generator sigma2 modifies only free-word coordinates1,2, so F0 and R0 are literally fixed; the evaluated six-crossing block returns the fixed top A8 tuple and can be iterated.
